{"parse":{"title":"DAX","pageid":34153,"redirects":[],"wikitext":"{{Short description|Blue chip stock market index}} {{Other uses|Dax (disambiguation)}} {{Use dmy dates|date=January 2025}} {{bots|deny=Citation bot}} {{Infobox index |name = DAX |logo = DAX-logo.svg |image = Dax-chart-1959-2019.png |Currency Euro|foundation = 1 July 1988 |operator = [[STOXX]] ([[Qontigo]], [[Deutsche Börse]]) |exchanges = [[Frankfurt Stock Exchange]] |constituents = 40 (expanded from 30 in 2021) |cap_level = Large cap |mcap = [[Euro|€]]1.891 trillion (March 2025){{Cite web|url=https://stoxx.com/index/daxnr/|title=1-DAX (DAXNR) (DE000A1A4D00)|website=STOXX}} |weighting = [[Capitalization-weighted index|Capitalization-weighted]] |related = [[MDAX]], [[SDAX]], [[TecDAX]] |homepage = [https://www.boerse-frankfurt.de/indices/dax?mic=XETR Official website] }} The '''DAX''' (''Deutscher Aktienindex'' (German stock index); {{IPA|de|daks|-|De-DAX.ogg}}) is a [[stock market index]] consisting of the 40 major German [[Blue chip (stock market)|blue chip]] companies trading on the [[Frankfurt Stock Exchange]]. It is a [[total return index]]. Prices are taken from the [[Xetra (trading system)|Xetra]] trading venue. According to [[Deutsche Börse]], the operator of Xetra, DAX measures the performance of the [[Prime Standard]]'s 40 largest German companies in terms of order book volume and market capitalization.{{Cite web|url=http://deutsche-boerse.com/dbag/dispatch/en/isg/gdb_navigation/private_investors/20_Equities/20_Indices/10_DAX?module=InOverview_Index&wp=DE0008469008&wplist=DE0008469008&foldertype=_Index|title=DAX|website=deutsche-boerse.com|access-date=1 April 2007|archive-date=29 September 2007|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20070929111611/http://deutsche-boerse.com/dbag/dispatch/en/isg/gdb_navigation/private_investors/20_Equities/20_Indices/10_DAX?module=InOverview_Index&wp=DE0008469008&wplist=DE0008469008&foldertype=_Index|url-status=live}} DAX is the equivalent of the UK [[FTSE 100]] and the US [[Dow Jones Industrial Average]], and because of its small company selection it does not necessarily represent the vitality of the German economy as a whole. The L-DAX Index is an indicator of the German benchmark DAX index's performance after the Xetra trading venue closes based on the [[floor trading]] at the Börse Frankfurt trading venue. The L-DAX Index basis is the "floor" trade (''Parketthandel'') at the Frankfurt stock exchange; it is computed daily between 09:00 and 17:45 Hours CET.{{cite web|url=https://www.xetra.com/resource/blob/250972/24d50260d22cd63e0f600ae2543ca529/data/handelsparameter-xetra.pdf|title=Trading Parameter Xetra Frankfurt|publisher=[[Xetra (trading system)|Xetra]]|date=23 November 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210826023256/https://www.xetra.com/resource/blob/250972/24d50260d22cd63e0f600ae2543ca529/data/handelsparameter-xetra.pdf|archive-date=2021-08-26|url-status=live}} The L/E-DAX index (Late/Early DAX) is calculated from 17:55 to 22:00 CET and from 08:00 to 09:00 CET. The [[Eurex]], a European electronic futures and options exchange based in [[Zurich]], Switzerland with a subsidiary in [[Frankfurt]], Germany, offers options (ODAX) and Futures (FDAX) on the DAX from 01:10 to 22:00 CET or from 02:10 to 22:00 CEST.{{cite web|url=https://www.eurex.com/resource/blob/1412768/e61a2c41d65ad165af7909002223b943/data/er18088e.pdf|title=Extension of trading hours for selected benchmark futures and MSCI futures|publisher=[[Eurex Exchange]]|date=15 November 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210826023630/https://www.eurex.com/resource/blob/1412768/e61a2c41d65ad165af7909002223b943/data/er18088e.pdf|archive-date=2021-08-26|url-status=live}} The Base date for the DAX is 30 December 1987, and it was started from a base value of 1,000. The Xetra technology calculates the index every second since 1 January 2006. On 24 Nov 2020, Deutsche Börse announced an expansion of the DAX from 30 to 40 members and a tightening of rules in response to the [[Wirecard scandal|Wirecard accounting scandal]].{{Cite news|url=https://www.reuters.com/article/deutsche-boerse-dax-idUSL8N2IA0QV|title=Germany's DAX to expand to 40 members from 30 in index shake-up|date=24 November 2020|agency=Reuters|archive-date=8 December 2020|access-date=20 May 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201208133236/https://www.reuters.com/article/deutsche-boerse-dax-idUSL8N2IA0QV|url-status=live}} The expansion occurred in the 3rd quarter of 2021.{{Cite web|url=https://www.metro.us/germanys-dax-index-gets/|title=Germany's DAX index gets shake-up in wake of Wirecard scandal – Metro US|first1=Shriya|last1=Ramakrishnan|first2=Shivani|last2=Kumaresan|website=metro.us|date=24 November 2020|access-date=20 May 2021|archive-date=8 December 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201208133323/https://www.metro.us/germanys-dax-index-gets/|url-status=live}} == Versions == The DAX has two versions, called performance index and price index, depending on whether dividends are counted. The performance index, which measures [[total return]], is the more commonly quoted, however the price index is more similar to commonly quoted indexes in other countries.{{Citation needed|date=August 2021}} == Contract specifications == DAX futures are traded on the Deutsche Borse Indices & ETF exchange (DBIndex).
